meta.title: Check the status of a bike — Velopass
meta.description: Check whether a bike is registered in the Velopass Community — no account needed, in seconds.
meta.ogDescription: Check a bike via its Velopass code or brand + frame number.

page.title: Check the status of a bike
page.subtitle: Check whether a bike is registered in the Velopass Community — no account needed, in seconds.

method_a.title: Via the Velopass code
method_a.desc: Scan the QR-code on the Frame-ID or enter the Velopass code manually.

method_b.title: Via brand and frame number
method_b.desc: Search using the brand and frame number of the bike.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

status_overview.title: Three possible outcomes
status_overview.subtitle: After searching you will always see one of these three statuses.
status_overview.secured_group_label: SECURED — Registered in the Velopass Community
status_overview.not_secured_group_label: NOT SECURED — Not registered in Velopass
status_overview.order_frameid_hint: Protect your bike with a Velopass Frame-ID — available via a bike shop or our webshop.
status_overview.register_bike_hint: You already have a Frame-ID on your bike. Register it in a few steps.

all_clear.title: Free and safe
all_clear.body: Registered in the Velopass Community and not reported as missing.

reported.title: Reported as missing
reported.body: Registered and actively reported by the owner. The Velopass Community is helping search.

not_registered.title: Not registered
not_registered.body: This bike is not in the Velopass database. It is not protected yet.

result.secured_body: This bike is registered in the Velopass Community and has not been reported as missing.
result.secured_cta: Is this your bike? Open your Velopass →
result.reported_body: This bike is registered and actively reported by its owner. The Velopass Community is searching actively.
result.not_registered_body: This bike is not in the Velopass database. Register it to protect it.
